title: Wayfare Bikes and Scooters Ride Pricing Rules
content:
**Rule.** Wayfare Bikes and Scooters rides are charged only on an active plan; a suspended plan cannot unlock vehicles. Each ride is charged the plan's unlock fee plus minute charges by vehicle type:

- classic bike minutes beyond the plan's included classic minutes, at the plan's classic per-minute rate, booked as a separate overtime fee entry apart from the ride charge;
- e-bike minutes beyond the plan's free e-bike minutes per ride, at the plan's e-bike per-minute rate, up to the plan's cap on an e-bike ride's minute charges;
- scooter minutes at the plan's scooter per-minute rate.

Minutes are rounded up to the next whole minute. A rider may have at most the plan's number of vehicles unlocked at once, each charged as its own ride under the rider's plan. Scooters require the scooter minimum age and cannot be unlocked during the night scooter curfew. When the destination station is full and the rider docks at the next station, the plan's station-full extra minutes are added to the included minutes.

**Which record decides.** The plan the ride is under, as the company's plan record shows its status before the ride is charged. Only the status active qualifies.

## Input, judgement, output

| Input | Judgement | Output |
|---|---|---|
| status of the plan the ride is under | active | the ride is charged under the plan |
| status of the plan the ride is under | suspended | the plan cannot unlock vehicles |
| ride length | round up to the next whole minute | the ride's minutes |
| destination station full, rider docked at the next station | the station-full extra minutes are added to the included minutes | the included minutes for that ride |
| classic bike ride | minutes beyond the included minutes | an overtime fee entry for those minutes at the classic rate; the ride charge holds the unlock fee |
| e-bike ride | minutes beyond the free e-bike minutes, at the e-bike rate, the total of those minute charges limited to the cap | the ride charge: the unlock fee plus the capped e-bike minute charges |
| scooter ride | every minute at the scooter rate | the ride charge: the unlock fee plus the scooter minute charges |

A ride charge is dated the day the ride ended and records the moment of unlock, the vehicle and the ride length in whole minutes; it may be 0.00. An overtime fee entry exists only for a classic bike ride that has minutes beyond the included minutes.

## Worked rides (hypothetical figures)

The figures below are illustrative only and are no plan's tariff: an unlock fee of 0.50; 30 included classic minutes at 0.20 a minute beyond them; 10 free e-bike minutes, then 0.30 a minute, with e-bike minute charges capped at 4.00; scooters at 0.25 a minute; 10 station-full extra minutes.

1. **Classic bike, 41 minutes 20 seconds.** Counted as 42 minutes; 12 minutes lie beyond the 30 included. Overtime fee entry: 12 minutes at 0.20, which comes to 2.40. Ride charge: the unlock fee of 0.50.
2. **E-bike, 25 minutes 10 seconds.** Counted as 26 minutes; 16 lie beyond the 10 free minutes. 16 minutes at 0.30 come to 4.80, which the cap limits to 4.00. Ride charge: 0.50 and 4.00 together, 4.50.
3. **Scooter, 9 minutes 30 seconds.** Counted as 10 minutes at 0.25, which comes to 2.50. Ride charge: 0.50 and 2.50 together, 3.00.
4. **Classic bike, 38 minutes, destination station full, docked at the next station.** The included minutes become 30 and 10 together, 40; all 38 minutes fall within them, so there is no overtime fee entry. Ride charge: 0.50.
5. **Two vehicles unlocked together by one rider on a plan allowing two.** Each vehicle is charged as its own ride, each worked as above.
